missionsWelcomeDialog.overviewBody: A <term>mission</term> takes on work that would keep a team busy for weeks: a framework migration, a feature that spans several services, a backlog of bugs. A team of droids works on it in parallel for hours or days, and the work comes back as pull requests ready for review.

continuousLoops.title: Organize work into continuous loops
continuousLoops.body: The Software Factory turns your team’s work into workstreams: fully autonomous, end-to-end pipelines where droids take everything from understanding what should be built to keeping shipped software healthy. Signals flow in; reviewed, high-quality tasks flow out. Your job moves up a level: you design, refine, and approve the factory itself.

signalsAndChanges.title: Signals & tasks
signalsAndChanges.body: A <term>signal</term> is any information about what your software should be: a bug report, a Sentry spike, a CVE, a customer ask. A <term>task</term> is the unit of work the factory stages in response. Signals in, tasks out.

workstreamsAndTeams.title: Workstreams & teams
workstreamsAndTeams.body: A <term>workstream</term> owns one job continuously: Billing KTLO, CVE remediation. Group workstreams into nested <term>teams</term> to mirror your org: the blueprint of your company’s factory.

automations.title: Automations
automations.body: Droids drive every workstream: <term>intake</term> listens, <term>triage</term> decides, <term>workers</term> build, <term>stewards</term> shepherd PRs to merge. You refine them by talking to droid. The factory improves itself.
